Non-regulated repositories: 1 approval per merge, automatic merge after CI passes, emergency bypass as in current draft, records retained for 90 days.
Repositories with unresolved CODEOWNERS patterns fall back to eng-oncall reviewer group and trigger an alert when ownership is unresolved.

Omar to update the draft with confirmed regulated repository compliance requirements.
